01-order-confirmation.trigger: Order confirmed · when paid (card / Tabby / Tamara) or placed with cash on delivery → Processing

02-complete-order-30min.trigger: Pending · 30 minutes after an unfinished order, any payment method

03-complete-order-24h.trigger: Pending · 24 hours later, if still unfinished (last reminder)

04-order-on-hold.trigger: On hold · sent only by hand: “Send on-hold email” on the order screen

05-order-shipped.trigger: Shipped · status → Shipped (untick “Email the customer” to skip)

08-order-refunded.trigger: Refunded · when a refund is sent (full or part)

10-new-order-alert.trigger: To you · new order paid or placed (COD)

11-order-invoice.trigger: Invoice · “Email invoice” button on an order

12-back-in-stock.trigger: Back in stock · a product they asked about returns (module)

13-basket-reminder.trigger: Basket reminder · basket left with an email (module)

14-account-invite.trigger: Account invite · sent from Customers → Send account invite

15-newsletter-confirm.trigger: Newsletter · sign-up on the website (double opt-in)

16-quiz-plan.trigger: Skin quiz · quiz finished with an email

17-password-reset.trigger: Password reset · customer asks for one (always on)
